headline: The gold transfer code is right under the KB's rule to use the highest tier that applies, but a lower-tier code describes this exact flyer scenario word for word.

issues.summary: The Tier 1 code customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal and the Tier 2 code unconfirmed_external_communication both describe a customer persisting about an unverifiable flyer offer. Only the meta-rule "select from the highest tier that applies" picks Tier 1.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042: "always select from the highest tier that applies"

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 Tier 1: "customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal | Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human"

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 Tier 2: "unconfirmed_external_communication | Customer claims a specific promotion/program/offer exists (they have a letter, email, or flyer) but you cannot verify or find it in the KB after searching"
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that matches on the word "flyer" picks the Tier 2 code and fails ACTION grading. The tier rule resolves it, so the correct answer is determinate.
issues.suggested_fix: Tell the two codes apart explicitly (for example: Tier 2 when the customer accepts an agent-offered transfer, Tier 1 when the customer demands one after repeated refusals).

solution_check: None of the three flyer offers is available to a non-business customer: no card has a $1,000 credit for $10,000 in 2 months (only Business Bronze has $500 for that spend); no 3-year 0% FTF promo exists; the only first-year fee waiver (platinum_009) ran 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31. After repeated refusals the customer demands a human. That meets every clause of the Tier 1 code, which outranks Tier 2 and the Tier 3 customer_frustrated_demands_human, so the gold reason follows.
prior_note: Prior rated this Minor for the same reason-code overlap resolved by the tier rule; unchanged in v1.0.1.
notes: Grading-model check (snapshot v1.0.1): confirmed _derive_read_log_allowlist, parse_int=float in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool, apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float, Action.compare_with_tool_call ignores requestor, fixed clock get_now()=2025-11-14 03:40:00. Verified scorer (_verified_db_match in working repo) read: only agent_discoverable_tools is relaxed (gold tool-name subset) and closure_reason is stripped; every other table exact. ACTION grading compares only reason, so the summary text is free. Business Silver's "First-year promotional annual fee for new customers: 0" is a business card and the customer is explicitly not a business owner.
